ebscohost (3).point: 好假设要可测试、精确、单一，写清谁、付多少、做什么
ebscohost (3).core: A well-formed business hypothesis describes a testable, precise, and discrete thing you want to investigate.
ebscohost (3).caseTitle: 按年级定制的科学盒子
ebscohost (3).case: We believe millennial parents with kids ages 5–9 will pay $15 a month for curated science projects that match their kids’ education level.
ebscohost (3).explain: 该假设明确锁定人群（5–9岁孩子的千禧父母）、价格（每月15美元）与产品（匹配教育水平的科学项目），成功标准清晰可测，正是精确单一假设的范例。

BlandDavidJOste_2020_Experiment_TestingB.point: 证据不会自己说话，要把多个实验的证据放在一起分析
BlandDavidJOste_2020_Experiment_TestingB.core: Evidence does not speak on its own. Gather the evidence you have from different experiments for a specific hypothesis and analyze it.
BlandDavidJOste_2020_Experiment_TestingB.case: Month of February: “science fair ideas” had 5k–10k searches. “kindergarten science fair ideas” had 10k–15k searches. “first grade science fair ideas” had 1k–5k searches. “second grade science fair ideas” had less than 1k searches. “third grade science fair ideas” had less than 1k searches. Concierge Data EVIDENCE STRENGTH Time to Create = 2 hours for each kit Cost to Create = $10–$15 Cost to Ship = $5–$8 Parent Customer Satisfaction Score = Partially Satisfied
BlandDavidJOste_2020_Experiment_TestingB.explain: 搜索量数据、礼宾式实验的成本与满意度数据来自不同类型实验，单看各自有限，合起来才能判断需求与可行性。

BlandDavidJOste_2020_DiscoveryExperiment.point: 亲眼观察客户真实使用，才能弥补说与做之间的差距
BlandDavidJOste_2020_DiscoveryExperiment.core: There is nothing more effective than observing a customer when and where they are actually experiencing the pain and problems we are trying to solve.
BlandDavidJOste_2020_DiscoveryExperiment.case: In those days software was installed on a physical computer via floppy discs (sounds crazy), so Scott and our product teams asked real customers if they could watch them install the software after it was purchased. Through observation, product teams uncovered new insights, and complete surprises about how customers actually used our software in the real world.
BlandDavidJOste_2020_DiscoveryExperiment.explain: Intuit 团队到客户家中观察软件安装过程，发现访谈中听不到的真实使用细节与意外，证明直接观察行为比只听客户陈述更能揭示真实问题。

BlandDavidJOste_2020_EmailCampaign_Testi.point: 粗糙的实体原型能让人一眼看到问题，快速对齐判断
BlandDavidJOste_2020_EmailCampaign_Testi.core: 3D print is ideal for rapidly testing iterations of your physical solution with customers.
BlandDavidJOste_2020_EmailCampaign_Testi.case: The team set out to devise a way to help these stakeholders quickly and unequivocally see the need for a new solution. After a few failed attempts, the team and their coach wondered if using a 3D-printer to create a life-sized mockup of the CubeSat might help them see it. They were ready the next day! Evidence The stakeholders immediately saw the need for a new solution after seeing how the currently certified encryption product simply wouldn’t fit in the 3D printed mock-up!
BlandDavidJOste_2020_EmailCampaign_Testi.explain: 团队用3D打印等比例立方星模型，利益相关者看到现有加密产品根本装不进去，立刻意识到需要新方案，无需冗长论证。

BlandDavidJOste_2020_CardSorting_Testing.point: 礼宾式实验用人工交付价值，先验证需求再谈规模
BlandDavidJOste_2020_CardSorting_Testing.explain: 用户点击行动号召并回答问卷后，产品经理 Dave Masters 手工整合信息生成 PDF 交付，全程由人完成价值交付，借此低成本验证买卖房时机这一需求是否真实，再决定是否自动化。
BlandDavidJOste_2020_CardSorting_Testing.core: Concierge is ideal for learning firsthand about steps needed to create, capture, and deliver value to a customer.
BlandDavidJOste_2020_CardSorting_Testing.case: The team did a simple concierge experiment that was triggered by a call to action. When clicked, the modal window highlighting a value proposition for insights on timing your ability to buy and sell at the same time appeared. Users would then click through a series of questions. Once complete, Dave Masters (the product manager) manually created the output by piecing together insights from other parts found throughout Realtor.com into a PDF.

BlandDavidJOste_2020_WizardOfOz_TestingB.point: 模拟销售可在开发前测试不同价格档位
BlandDavidJOste_2020_WizardOfOz_TestingB.core: Mock sale is ideal for determining different price points for your product.
BlandDavidJOste_2020_WizardOfOz_TestingB.case: Joel decided to test viability by adding three different payment tier options to the landing page. Free = $0/month for 1 tweet a day and 5 tweets in your buffer queue. Standard = $5/month for 10 tweets a day and 50 tweets in your buffer queue. Max = $20/month for unlimited tweets a day and unlimited tweets in your buffer queue.
BlandDavidJOste_2020_WizardOfOz_TestingB.explain: Buffer 在落地页挂出免费、5美元、20美元三档，用各档注册量判断用户最愿接受的价格，无需先开发产品即可验证定价。
